title: Guided Physical Activity Counseling: A Pilot Study
official: Guided Physical Activity Counseling: A Pilot Study
summary: This 1-arm pilot study will test the feasibility of recruitment and use of the Physical Activity Counseling Tool (PACT) in 40 UC San Diego Health patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Providers will be eligible if they:

-currently work for UC San Diego Health

Patients will be eligible if:

* they are receiving care from one of the enrolled providers;
* their enrolled provider thinks they can engage in unsupervised physical activity; -they are engaging in \<150 minutes/week of moderate intensity exercise;
* they are between 18 and 80 years old;
* they have a smartphone or tablet compatible with the Fitbit app

Exclusion Criteria:

Providers will be excluded if they:

-are planning to leave UCSD in the next 12 months

Patients will be excluded if they:

* have any condition that would contraindicate unsupervised exercise as determined by their provider
* plan to change healthcare providers within the next 2 months
* have a planned surgery or procedure that could impact mobility within the next 3 months;
* are pregnant
